# Bid the containment, the demo, and the clearance.

> Price a mold remediation job from extra containment zones, demolition, HEPA and dehumidifier days, HVAC cleaning, dumpster, occupied-home access, and third-party clearance — not a published $999 mold special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper closet quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
